RafiiRoot.description: The one root of every view: root = RafiiRoot([...]). Children stack vertically. title is an optional short heading.

Stack.description: Groups components in a column (default) or a wrapping row. gap: sm | md | lg.

Grid.description: Responsive grid of 1 to 4 columns that collapses to one column in narrow spaces such as the side panel.

Section.description: A titled region of the view. Use for each distinct part of a dense answer.

Card.description: A bordered surface for one item or one idea. tone: default | muted | highlight.

Tabs.description: Switches between TabItem panels locally. Bind value to a $variable to let other components react to the open tab.

TabItem.description: One tab of Tabs. value is a stable id; it defaults to the label.

Accordion.description: Collapsible sections for secondary detail such as methods, definitions or long lists.

AccordionItem.description: One collapsible part of an Accordion.

Text.description: Plain text you write (commentary, a heading or a caption). Never type figures, record titles, statuses or sources here: show those through bound data components.

EmptyState.description: Says that nothing matched or that no data exists yet. Use it when no binding fits the request: never invent data.

LoadingState.description: A quiet placeholder while something is being prepared.

ErrorState.description: Explains that something could not be shown, in plain words, with what the person can do next.

ToolBoundTable.description: A table of rows from a Query. columns pick fields of each row. Sorting is local. To page, pass the same $variable as the Query's cursor argument and as cursor here, e.g. Query("name", {cursor: $page}, null). Unknown values show as "Not available", never as zero. rowsField names the list inside the result when the data is not itself a list (for example "drafts").

ToolBoundChart.description: A line or bar chart of rows from a Query: x is the field for the horizontal axis, series are numeric fields. Missing values stay gaps, never zero. A data table alternative is always included. rowsField names the list inside the result when the data is not itself a list (for example "drafts").

Metric.description: One server-computed figure from a field of a Query result (dots reach nested fields, for example "totals.reach"), with its unit, as-of time and coverage. Shows "Not measured" when the value is unknown.

Timeline.description: Rows from a Query in time order, with dates in the person’s time zone. rowsField names the list inside the result when the data is not itself a list (for example "drafts").

Comparison.description: Side-by-side comparison of rows from a Query (for example drafts or campaigns). Bind selected to a $variable holding row ids to compare only those. rowsField names the list inside the result when the data is not itself a list (for example "drafts").

TaskStatus.description: The real state of a task or record from a Query (for example preparing, needs review, saved, scheduled, published). The state shown is exactly what the data says.

EvidenceLink.description: A link to a source or record. href is an in-app path such as "/app/library", or a URL taken from bound data. Never invent a web address.

SelectionList.description: Lets the person pick rows from a Query. value is a $variable that receives the picked row ids in the order they were picked. max limits how many. rowsField names the list inside the result when the data is not itself a list (for example "drafts").

AssetPreview.description: A safe preview of one Library item (image, video, audio, document or link) taken from bound data, for example inside @Each over a Query result. size: row | card | detail.

Form.description: Groups input fields under one name. Put an ActionButton inside to submit them through a registered action.

TextField.description: A labelled text input. Bind value to a $variable to use it in Query arguments or other components.

Select.description: A labelled choice from options. Bind value to a $variable to filter a Query or switch what is shown.

DateRange.description: Start and end dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in the person’s time zone, at most 366 days apart. Bind value to a $variable and pass it to a Query.

Button.description: A local control that never changes saved data: Action([@Set($v, x)]), @Reset, @Run(query) to refresh, @ToAssistant("follow-up") or @OpenUrl("/app/…"). variant: primary | secondary | quiet.

ActionButton.description: Starts one registered action by its id. Its label, confirmation and result come from Rafii, never from you. Inside a Form it sends that form’s fields; inputs adds bound values such as {draftIds: $picked}.

Commentary.description: Your own short explanation, shown apart from the records and labelled as Rafii’s note. Never put figures, dates, titles or statuses in it: those come from bound components.

TaskProgress.description: Steps of this conversation’s multi-step task from a task_progress Query: done, open, blocked and failed, with reasons. A step shows done only when the tool that did it says so.

DraftList.description: Drafts from a drafts_list Query: platform, language, length against the platform limit, review and queue state. Bind selected to a $variable (draft ids, in the order picked). Picking only selects.

DraftCompare.description: Two to four picked drafts side by side, in the order picked: data is a drafts_list Query whose ids argument is the selection $variable, and selected is that same $variable.

DraftDetail.description: One draft from a draft_read Query as it will read on its platform: full text, length against the limit, open questions, warnings, a waiting rewrite and its queue state.

DraftEvidence.description: Where one draft came from (draft_evidence Query): its sources with approved facts, linked records and the voice check.

DraftEditor.description: Edit the text of one unscheduled draft from a draft_read Query. name is the form field name. Saving shows Rafii’s confirmation; drafts already in the queue cannot be edited here.

CalendarAgenda.description: Scheduled, waiting and planned posts from a calendar_agenda Query, by day, each time in its zone, with rule-labelled close-together notes. Bind selected to a $variable to pick a waiting post (job id).

RescheduleForm.description: Pick a local date and time for a waiting post (target "job") or a draft (target "draft") and prepare a schedule proposal. targetId, when ("YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM") and zone (IANA) are $variables. Nothing is scheduled until the person applies the proposal on its card.

SlotCheck.description: Whether a chosen local time works and which posts on the same account are less than 2 hours away (slot_check Query). Read only.

QueueStatus.description: The publishing queue now (queue_status Query): waiting for approval, approved and waiting for their time, needing attention.

ProposalList.description: Proposals in this conversation still waiting for the person (open_proposals Query). They are applied only on their own card.

LibraryBrowser.description: Library results from a library_search Query (photos, videos, audio, documents) with type, size, tags and processing state. Bind selected to a $variable (asset ids, up to 4, in the order picked). Picking only selects.

LibraryAssetCard.description: One Library item from a library_item Query: details, a bounded text excerpt and whether Rafii may look at it. actionId "library_use_as_source" offers importing a document as a source that still needs review.

LibraryLineage.description: Where a Library item came from and what was made from it (library_lineage Query), each link with the stored field it comes from.

LibrarySelectionCheck.description: What a selection of Library items becomes in the next message (library_selection Query with assetIds = the selection $variable): attachments, sources, and why anything can’t be used yet.

VoiceSourcePicker.description: Writing samples from a voice_sources Query with each sample’s exact use grants and, when purpose and route are given, why a sample is excluded. Bind selected to a $variable (sample ids). Picking only selects.

VoiceAnalyzeLocal.description: Analyse the picked samples with Rafii’s local rules (no AI, no cost) into a proposed profile. samples is the selection $variable.

VoiceProfileReview.description: The voice in effect next to the proposed one (voice_profile_state Query), each observation with its evidence level, and how many drafts an approval affects. actionId "voice_profile_approve" lets an owner approve the proposal shown.

VoicePreferenceList.description: Learned preferences in effect and proposals waiting for an owner (voice_preferences Query). actionId "preference_decide" offers Remember / Dismiss on each proposal.

VoiceConsentPanel.description: Every consent layer separately from a voice_consent Query: sample grants, cloud memory, learning from edits, photo processing and web research. Changes happen on the Memory page.

VoiceLearningStatus.description: What learning is doing now (voice_learning_status Query): on or off, edits waiting, proposals waiting. Rafii trains no model.

VoiceSampleImport.description: Paste writing to keep as a private style sample, with the person’s explicit confirmation. name is the form field name.

CampaignList.description: Campaign briefs from a campaigns_list Query with status, platforms and missing details. Bind selected to a $variable (one campaign id).

CampaignPlan.description: One campaign from a campaign_detail Query: goal, audience, details, automations with next run, derived gaps and derived progress, each with its rule.

CampaignItems.description: Every draft, post and image linked to a campaign (campaign_items Query) with its current state.

CampaignTimeline.description: A campaign’s planned runs, past runs and linked posts by day from a campaign_timeline Query, each time in its zone.

CampaignBriefForm.description: Goal, audience, date and venue form that creates a campaign brief after confirmation. name is the form name. Nothing is drafted, scheduled or published.

CampaignBriefEditor.description: Edit the goal and audience of the campaign in a campaign_detail Query, at the version shown. name is the form name. Saving pauses its active automations until resumed.

CampaignLinkDrafts.description: Add picked drafts to the campaign in a campaign_detail Query (organisation only). drafts is the draft-selection $variable or the draft ids the person referred to.

MetricTable.description: Published posts from an analytics_posts Query with each metric’s stored reading (or why it is missing), its read time and definition version. metrics picks up to 6 columns.

MetricChart.description: One metric over time per account from an analytics_series Query, line or bar, with gaps where nothing was read and the numbers as a table.

ComparisonSummary.description: Like-for-like comparison from an analytics_compare Query: sample size, measured, missing and the minimum sample. Observations only, never causes.

CoverageNote.description: Which accounts share analytics, how many published posts have readings, and how to turn analytics on (analytics_coverage Query).

PostFeedback.description: One published post’s readings against the account’s own usual results (post_feedback Query), when post feedback is on.

ResearchStatus.description: Whether web research may run for this workspace and, when it is off, why and how to turn it on (research_state Query).

ResearchBrief.description: Pages this answer’s research returned (research_results Query): title, site, date or "no date", read time and quoted facts. Bind selected to a $variable to pick pages; actionId "research_save_sources" saves the picked pages as sources.

ComparisonMatrix.description: Research pages side by side (research_results Query): site, date and quoted facts. selected narrows the columns to the picked pages.

SavedSources.description: Web sources saved in this workspace (research_sources Query) with site, date, read time and approved facts.

AutomationList.description: Every live automation from an automations_list Query: status, schedule, time zone, policy, platforms and next run. Bind selected to a $variable (one automation id).

AutomationDetail.description: One automation from an automation_detail Query: plan, what it still needs and its next runs in its own time zone.

RunHistory.description: An automation’s recent runs from an automation_history Query: when, status, outcome per platform and cost (unknown stays unknown).

ConnectionHealth.description: Connected accounts from a connections_status Query: state, verified capability levels, whether posts can publish, and the in-app way to fix one.

RecoveryGuides.description: The in-app step-by-step guides that fix common problems (recovery_guides Query).

AutomationChangeForm.description: Describe a change to the picked automation (automation is the selection $variable) and prepare it as a proposal. name is the form field name. Nothing changes until the person applies it on its card.
